integrity: Contains an all-integer analytical proof and a standalone exact-rational regression checker. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact canonical orthogonal projections only, not arbitrary norm-minimizing projections. Exact-rational checks are finite n=2..8; all-n proof is analytic. Potential prior equivalences outside inspected literature remain a risk.
title: Sharp three-orbit Hodge projection transitions for three-layer clique strips
